verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice platform, so latency and turn-taking performance is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents end-to-end voice latency numbers or latency-tuning guidance. The metrics it does document (reach rate, call duration, success rate) and the test-call features are about other things and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
